idea-plugin.name: Glance Icons
idea-plugin.description:
Colourful, pixel-sharp file and folder icons that make the project tree easier to scan.

  • 1,700+ file types and 340+ folders, from Makefile and Dockerfile to Office documents and infra folders.
  • Official icons for HTML, CSS, TypeScript, Docker, Maven, Gradle, Kubernetes, Helm, Azure Pipelines, Bicep, React, Next.js and many more.
  • Pixel-sharp folders: every folder outline is redrawn on the 16 px grid.
  • One icon per Angular type: components, services, directives, pipes, guards, interceptors, routes, modules, stores and models, found by file name or by the decorator inside the file, including Angular 22's @Service() and files named after the 2025 style guide (user-card.ts).
  • Kubernetes manifests by content: any YAML file with apiVersion and kind gets the Kubernetes icon.
  • Test badges for Java and Kotlin test classes, in the project tree too.
  • Works in light and dark themes and in every JetBrains IDE.

Source roots and content roots keep the IDE's own icons, so you don't lose that information. Third-party artwork and its licenses are listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md, inside the plugin and in the GitHub repository.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.1: reworded plugin description. Icons and behaviour are unchanged.

1.1.0: icons for 1,700+ file types and 340+ folders, with pixel-sharp folders; official icons for Docker, Maven, Gradle, Kubernetes, Azure and more; Kubernetes manifests recognised by content; a pixel-sharp TypeScript icon for .ts files, with its own drawing for Retina screens; Angular components get a C with the Angular logo, also where the catalogue would guess another framework from the name (app.ts, layout.ts); the new Angular logo for angular.json; Angular and Java icons redrawn on the pixel grid; new logo.

1.0.1: no more deprecated-API warnings from the JetBrains Plugin Verifier. Icons and behaviour are unchanged.

1.0.0: first release.
